User Story

I want to be able to configurate Collection channel for receiving offline payments from provider

So that System will retrieve payment files on predefined time and import it in system according collection channel

 

 

Acceptance Criteria

Should be implemented JOB which will run hourly and will check all offline type collection channels.

  1. Check data receiving schedule field and start retrieving payments and importing in system according to predefined RRule formula.

    1. Example:
      Repeat Monthly

      every 2 month(s)

      on day 31

      End On date Sep 02, 2024

      RRULE: FREQ=MONTHLY;BYMONTHDAY=31;INTERVAL=2;UNTIL=20240802T000000Z
      in this example, if today is 26 April, first process should be start on 31 May 00:00:00 and second process should be start on 31 Aug 00:00:00.

  2. Get file directory from collection channel’s “Folder for file receiving” field

  3. Retrieve file from this directory and export data from it2

    1. Check File Name.

      1. if File with such name is already imported in the system, skip the file.

      2. if File with such name is not yet imported in the system, start import process for this file.

  4. If directory is empty look collection channel’s Waiting period tolerance in hours field

    1. If it’s empty stop process

    2. If it’s filled, try to retrieve file from directory every 5 minute during filled hours

  5. txt file template will have predefined 2 type structure

    1. First type structure is for offline collection channel which type of file is payment partner

      1. In this txt structure system should read following fields:

        1. Customer number

          1. Start position - 1

          2. Length - 16

          3. Example
            6000054048 205342928 EE0416915113523.12 12345 70010
            Customer number will be 6000054048

        2. Customer identifier (UIC)

          1. Start position - 17

          2. Length - 10

          3. Example
            6000054048 205342928 EE0416915113523.12 12345 700104
            Customer identifier will be 205342928

          4. Should find customer with this UIC and and add it to payment as a sub-object (connection is ID)

        3. Billing group number

          1. Start position - 28

          2. Length - 20

          3. Example
            6000054048 205342928 EE0416915113523.12 12345 700104
            Customer identifier will be 205342928
            Billing group will be empty

          4. In payment object Billing group sub-object shouldn’t be added

          5. If billing group value in example should be filled System should find this billing group with its number and add in payment object as billing group a sub-object

        4. Invoice prefix

          1. Start position - 49

          2. Length - 2

          3. Example
            6000054048 205342928 EE0416915113523.12 12345 700104
            Invoice prefix will be EE

        5. Invoice Number

          1. Start position - 49

          2. Length - 10

          3. Example
            6000054048 205342928 EE0416915113523.12 12345 700104
            Invoice number will be 0416915113

          4. System should find invoice with Prefix & Invoice number, EE04169151135 and add it to payment object as a outgoing document Sub-object

        6. Amount with decimal dot

          1. Start position - 59

          2. Length - 10

          3. Example
            6000054048 205342928 EE0416915113523.12 12345 700104
            Amount will be 523.12

          4. System should input value in initial amount and current amount field

      2. In length counting for all field should include spaces, but when input value in payment object value should be trimmed and shouldn’t include spaces

      3. In txt file new row means new payment, separator for each payment should be row

      4. Before start importing process system should check file structure and collection channel’s type of file, are this txt file valid for this collection channel type ?

        1. If yes start import process

        2. If no display error in processes

      5. Process should create new payment object for each row in txt file

      6. Another fields for creating payment object which aren’t in txt file

        1. Collection channel

          1. In payment object Set same value which is filled in mass import object’s collection channel field

        2. Payment date

          1. In payment object Set value from payment package which should be created in process

        3. Payment package

          1. Should be generate new payment package for every mass import

          2. Collection channel should be same which is filled in collection channel

          3. Payment date should be previous day of importing date

          4. Accounting period should be for month according to payment date

        4. Accounting period

          1. Accounting period should be for month according to payment date from payment package

        5. Currency

          1. Currency from collection channel

    2. Second type structure is for offline collection channel which type of file is bank partner

      1. in this txt file System should find following initials and read text after it before next initial

        1. Initial to search :25:

          1. Initial meaning: Account identification for all payment, ENERGO-PRO IBAN

          2. Should be used for all payment

          3. This initial should be one time in txt file

          4. If there is more then one initial display error

          5. Read text after initial before next initial is started, next initial starting value is “:”, so read text after :25: before :

          6. Example
            :25:BG20STSA93000024288530
            :28C:038/01
            Catch following BG20STSA93000024288530

          7. System should input value in additional payment information field

        2. Initial to search :60F:

          1. Initial meaning: Currency

          2. Should be used for all payment

          3. This initial should be one time in txt file

          4. If there is more then one initial display error

          5. Search text ‘BGN’ or ‘EUR’ after initial before next initial is started, next initial starting value is “:”

          6. If Search returning more then one value display error

          7. Example
            :60F:C240315BGN24950,12
            :61:2403150315C657,96N022000001//290290300117817
            TC36-TSC00
            Should search ‘BGN’ or ‘EUR’ in C240315BGN24950,12 text.
            Result will bi BGN

          8. If searched text is ‘BGN’ System should input leva in currency field, if searched text is ‘EUR’ system should input euro in currency field

        3. Initial to search :61:

          1. Initial meaning: Payment date, Amount, Reference

          2. Quantity of this initial determines quantity of payment which should be created

          3. Quantity of this initial should be equal quantity of :86: initial

          4. If Quantity of this initial isn’t equal to quantity of :86: initial display error

          5. Each of this initial should be before :86: initial

          6. If any of this initial isn’t before :86: initial display error

          7. Read payment date after initial first 6 number, Format: YYMMDD.
            System should input it payment date field

          8. Find ‘C' and 'N’ after initial and read text between them, this will be amount (consider to convert comma to decimal)
            System should input it in initial amount and current amount field

          9. Find 'N' after initial and read text after it before new line
            System should input it in additional payment information field

          10. Example
            :61:2403150315C1297,30N022000006//067009992101711
            TC15-TSC81
            :NS:191010+
            Payment date: 240315 == 15 march 2024
            Amount: 1297,30 == 1297.30
            Reference: 022000006//067009992101711

        4. Initial to search :86:

          1. Initial meaning: Customer number, Invoice prefix & invoice number

          2. Quantity of this initial determines quantity of payment which should be created

          3. Quantity of this initial should be equal quantity of :81: initial

          4. If Quantity of this initial isn’t equal to quantity of :81: initial display error

          5. Each of this initial should be after :81: initial

          6. If any of this initial isn’t before :81: initial display error

          7. Read exact invoice prefix+number and customer number. another characters shouldn’t be included in txt file.

          8. Find ‘ÐÐÐÐ ÐÐÐ¯’ text after initial, search 14 digits after ‘ÐÐÐÐ ÐÐÐ¯’, trim it, after trim first 2 digit will be invoice prefix. search 10 digits in trimmed text after 3 digits ( from 4th to 14th) this will invoice number
            Find invoice in system with this invoice prefix & invoice number and input it in outgoing document sub-object

          9. Find first + after ‘ÐÐÐÐ ÐÐÐ¯’ text, find first space after +, search 10 digits after space
            This will be customer number
            Find customer with customer number and input it in customer sub-object (connection is customer ID)

          10. Example
            :86:020+14+
            20ÐÐ¢ÐÐ ÐÐÐÐ ÐÐÐ ÐÐ. ÐÐÐÐ ÐÐÐ¯ Ð¤Ð¢,04169156+
            2150Ð¤Ð¢0416915650, 6000031125,00000000+
            30CECB9790+
            31BG59CECB97901005191400+
            32ÐÐ ÐÐÐÐ Ð¦Ð ÐÐÐÐÐÐÐÐ¡ÐÐ ÐÐÐÐÐÐ +
            33ÐÐ¦ÐÐ¯
            :61:2403150315C552,14N022000020//297297009961502
            TC14-TSC30

          11. Read exact invoice prefix+number and customer number. another characters shouldn’t be included in txt file.

      2. Before start importing process system should check file structure and collection channel’s type of file, are this txt file valid for this collection channel type ?

        1. If yes start import process

        2. If no display error in processes

      3. Process should create new payment object for each :61: and :86: in txt file

      4. Before creation of payment Check collection channel’s, which is selected in mass import object, conditions of customer for each payment and if condition return true continue process, if no stop process for this payment

      5. Another fields for creating payment object which aren’t in txt file

        1. Collection channel

          1. In payment object Set same value which is filled in mass import object’s collection channel field

        2. Payment package

          1. Should be generate new payment package for every import

          2. Collection channel should be taken collection channel’s object

          3. Payment date should be taken from txt file

          4. Accounting period should be for month according to payment date

        3. Accounting period

          1. Accounting period should be taken from payment package

  6. All Payment related data should be possible to import

  7. If there are error in a row, from mandatory fields in this case this payment will not be created

  8. To display in report exact row and exact field in which error happened

  9. In start process system should have actions:

    1. Pause

      1. To be able to pause process

      2. Already imported customer payment will be visible in system

    2. Resume

      1. Action is available on Paused process

      2. After resuming process will continue from the point where it was paused

    3. Cancel

      1. User  have possibility to Cancel process

      2. Changes will stay in the system and no possibility to revert changes

  10. Audit Log record should be created for create/edit customer payment

  11. Audit Log record should be created for Import offline payment process itself and all changes should be logged:

    1. When Import offline payment process was started

    2. When Import offline payment process was paused/resumed

    3. When Import offline payment process was completed

    4. When Import offline payment process was cancelled

    5. When completing Import offline payment process, report in excel file is generated

      1. It is possible to download report from process detail page

        1. How many records were imported successfully

        2. How many records were failed (display row number and fields name in which error happened)

  12. When process is completed, notification should be sent automatically, who started the process will get notification
